2. The park's permit form `permit-form.pdf` filled in with the details Ines sent in `event-details.txt`, saved at

Honest limit: I could not render the PDF to a screenshot, so appearance (fonts/placement of the baked text) is not visually verified; the text layer and structure are.

Assumptions (the brief left them open): date format YYYY-MM-DD per the form label; attendees kept as "about 40" (the text says "about 40" — not a bare number); flattening means removing editable form fields, achieved by stripping annotations/AcroForm after baking appearances; crop centered on the detected balloon rather than full image. No browser/apps opened; scratch files cleaned up.
